Harmonized geospatial data summary

Published

October 31, 2026

Study area

Watershed: Elliotts Creek (HUC12 031601130302)
Area: 107.5 km²
Output CRS: EPSG:5070
Grid resolution: 10 m

Terrain and streams

Soils

K-factors are aggregated from SSURGO components and horizons (see the decision log). Both K maps share one color scale. Soil values are uniform within each map unit polygon, so their real spatial detail is the polygon, not the 10 m grid.

Precipitation

Rainfall intensity for the 2-year storm from NOAA Atlas 14 Volume 12 (partial duration series), converted from depth to intensity and resampled from about 800 m to the 10 m grid. Each map has its own color scale; intensity varies only a few percent across the watershed, so the smooth gradients show a small range.

Forest structure

Canopy cover and canopy height from LANDFIRE 2024, resampled from 30 m to the 10 m grid with nearest neighbor. LANDFIRE stores both as classes, so each map shows a small set of values, each representing a range.

Disturbance history

LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance, 1999 to 2025. Each year’s codes are translated with that year’s LANDFIRE attribute table and grouped by type (2_protocol/dist_type_groups.csv). Year maps show the most recent year of each disturbance group; blank areas had no disturbance of that group. LANDFIRE may under-record insect mortality, which develops gradually; see the decision log. LANDFIRE’s own disturbance type and severity labels, with the group and severity class assigned to each, are listed in 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_031601130302.csv.

disturbance LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance (final) via rlandfire::landfireAPIv2(); attribute tables from landfire.gov 1999-2025; products LF2001_Dist99, LF2001_Dist00, LF2001_Dist01, LF2001_Dist02, LF2001_Dist03, LF2001_Dist04, LF2001_Dist05, LF2001_Dist06, LF2001_Dist07, LF2008_Dist08, LF2010_Dist09, LF2010_Dist10, LF2012_Dist11, LF2012_Dist12, LF2014_Dist13, LF2014_Dist14, LF2016_Dist15, LF2016_Dist16, LF2020_Dist17, LF2020_Dist18, LF2020_Dist19, LF2020_Dist20, LF2022_Dist21, LF2022_Dist22, LF2023_Dist23, LF2024_Dist24, LF2025_Dist25; attribute tables dated 20250127, 20250727, 20250129, 20241022, 20241023, 20230426, 20241212, 20241219, 20260213; rlandfire 2.0.2 2026-10-31 21:46:43 MDT EPSG:5070 (NAD83 / Conus Albers) EPSG:5070 (NAD83 / Conus Albers) 10 x 10 Annual codes translated with each year’s own LANDFIRE attribute table; LANDFIRE DIST_TYPE values grouped into harvest, fire, insect, and other per 2_protocol/dist_type_groups.csv; LANDFIRE SEVERITY labels ranked 1 (low or unburned), 2 (medium or moderate), 3 (high) by their first word, and 0 when the label is not a severity class (e.g. No Severity). Summarized per cell at 30 m: each group keeps its own most recent year, so a cell with insect mortality that later burned has both an insect year and a fire year; dist_last_severity is the severity of the most recent disturbance of any group; dist_count is the number of years with any disturbance. Every source label with its assigned group and rank is listed in the watershed’s 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_[HUC12].csv. Resampled to common grid with nearest neighbor; masked to watershed; NoData = -9999.
